column3: “Present” is not expressed with this age.
The fruit becoming good or bad is made a result rather than an object of make.
“Have spoken” renders the future will speak.
“One greater” personalizes the neuter something greater; now renders behold.
“One greater” personalizes the neuter something greater; will rise renders the passive will be raised.
The recipient who was speaking to Him is omitted.
Pointing renders stretching out His hand.
